description: This file defines a Jetpack Compose UI component for a SettingsSheet in an Android app. It manages various device, media, notification, data-access, location, and preference settings, including permissions, roles, and system features. The file also includes helper functions for querying installed apps, managing permissions, and opening system settings.

classes.name: InstalledApp
classes.description: Data class representing an installed application's label, package name, and whether it is a system app.

methods.name: queryInstalledApps
methods.description: Queries installed apps that can launch and filters them based on recent notification packages and configured packages.

methods.name: resolveNotificationCandidatePackages
methods.description: Resolves the set of package names to consider for notification forwarding, excluding the app's own package.

methods.name: settingsTextFieldColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for text fields in the settings UI.

methods.name: Modifier.settingsRowModifier
methods.description: Extension function adding styling modifiers for settings rows.

methods.name: settingsPrimaryButtonColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for primary buttons in the settings UI.

methods.name: settingsDangerButtonColors
methods.description: Provides color configuration for danger buttons in the settings UI.

methods.name: openAppSettings
methods.description: Opens the application's system settings page.

methods.name: openNotificationListenerSettings
methods.description: Opens the notification listener settings in system preferences.

methods.name: hasNotificationsPermission
methods.description: Checks if the app has notification permission (Android 13+).

methods.name: isNotificationListenerEnabled
methods.description: Checks if notification listener access is enabled.

methods.name: hasMotionCapabilities
methods.description: Determines if the device has motion sensors available.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleAvailable
methods.description: Checks if the device's role management supports the assistant role.

methods.name: isAssistantRoleHeld
methods.description: Checks if the app currently holds the assistant role.
